name: Ribbon
notes: Rounded bookmark with two diagonal ribbon edges; click unfurls a doubled ribbon tail to the right. Toolbar has plain rounded line icons. stateAnchors use local bookmark-body centers.

name: Silk
notes: Bookmark outline has rounded corners and notch; hover broadens its shoulders; click bows its sides and rounds its bottom notch. Toolbar has rounded arrowheads and corners. stateAnchors use local bookmark-body centers.

name: Ivy
notes: Leaves and curling stems surround toolbar symbols. Rest bookmark has one central leaf and an upper-left vine; hover adds a four-leaf crown; click has two right-hand spiral tendrils. stateAnchors use local bookmark-body centers.

name: Ink
notes: Pointed arrowheads and bookmark notch. Rest has a short tapered notch extension; hover splits that line; click pulls the right edge into three swept curves ending in a rightward point. stateAnchors use local bookmark-body centers.

name: Frost
notes: Straight diagonal facets divide the arrow, reload loop, and bookmark. Rest and hover bookmark drawings are nearly identical; click adds a triangular shard at its upper-right edge. stateAnchors use local bookmark-body centers.

name: Ember
notes: Bookmark has a sweeping internal diagonal and narrow curled right edge. Hover doubles that inner curl; click extends it into a long crescent flame with a pointed right tip. stateAnchors use local bookmark-body centers.

name: Facet
notes: Polygon outlines with triangular internal facets; clicked bookmark splits into two separated halves.

name: Cyberpunk
notes: Circuit traces with round terminals and angular notches; clicked bookmark adds a right-side offset panel.

name: Razor
notes: Diagonal cuts divide outlined shapes; clicked bookmark adds a small circular turn mark along its diagonal gap.

name: Hologram
notes: Interrupted arc outlines and round nodes; bookmark states carry tilted orbit rings, with dashed rear arc in click state.

name: Brass
notes: Rounded metal-plate silhouettes drawn only as outlines with circular rivets; clicked bookmark carries a diagonal hinged plate.

name: Blueprint
notes: Outlined glyphs retain drafting ticks, construction axes and dimension extensions; clicked bookmark becomes an isometric outlined prism.

name: Gothic
notes: Pointed cathedral arches and trefoil; hover replaces trefoil with a four-point star; click retains the double lancet and trefoil.

name: Codex
notes: Fleur-de-lis ribbon; hover curls the page; click adds an inset rectangular frame.

name: Vampire
notes: Pointed bat-wing ribbon with diamond; hover spreads both wings; click narrows to a central diamond and downward spear.

name: Lunar
notes: Crescent ribbon with a hanging ring; hover adds the full orbital circle and side satellites; click replaces the crescent with concentric circles.

name: Deco
notes: Layered fan bookmark; hover widens the stepped fan; click introduces a small folded edge on the inner panel.

name: Pixel
notes: Stepped rectangular bookmark with a pixel V-notch; three reference states differ slightly in width and notch geometry.

name: Wyvern
notes: Outlined dragon heads, ribbed wings, horns and diamond emblems. Bookmark wings fold at rest, spread on hover and close around the body on click.

name: Wyrm
notes: Serpentine dragon silhouettes with coiled tails. Bookmark serpent crosses the left edge at rest, raises its head on hover and wraps across the front on click.

name: Dragonforged
notes: Angular dragon outlines, segmented rings, horns and nested chevrons. Bookmark gains two side plates on hover and becomes a pointed shield on click.
